title: File:Spangdahlem tax center onpens Feb 11 (5089781).jpg
art: U.S. Air Force 52FWPA by Airman 1st Class Branden Rae
desc: The tax center opens Feb. 11 to file a free federal and state return on Spangdahlem Air Base, Germany. Military members E-1 through E-9 and O-1 through O-4 will be served by appointment only, Monday through Thursday from 8 a.m. to 3 p.m. (U.S. Air Force illustration by Airman 1st Class Branden Rae)

title: File:Kaiserslautern tax centers open for business Feb. 2 150127-A-GM630-001.jpg
desc: Tamara Chapman, right, a 21st Theater Sustainment Command tax preparer, helps a service member prepare her tax return. Tax assistance centers on Kleber Kaserne, Pulaski Barracks and Landstuhl Regional Medical Center officially open Feb. 2. (Photo by Brandon Beach, 21st Theater Sustainment Command)
